title: JavaScriptBridge doesn't work with callbacks or promises on extension
body:
### Tested versions

- reproducible in 4.6Beta1
- reproducible in 4.6Beta2
- reproducible in 4.6Beta3

### System information

Godot v4.6.beta1 - Manjaro Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Fri, 19 Sep 2025 16:09:36 +0000 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) HD Graphics 4600 (HSW GT2) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-4700HQ CPU @ 2.40GHz (8 threads) - 15.49 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm trying to create a extension connection. callback
so that I get some info back from extension.

I expect when I do:
```gdscript

window.myDiv.addEventListener().then(my_call_back)
```

to still have call to the metamask at least.
but it blocks it.

### Steps to reproduce

1. add head <script src="metamask.js"></script> on export
2. export on web
3. add file to the exported folder:
[metamask.js](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24231810/metamask.js)
4. run the server in terminal: python3 -m http.server 8000
5. install metamask on brave browser ([Brave 1.84.132 (Official Build) (64-bit)](https://brave.com/latest/)
Chromium: 142.0.7444.60)
6. run the web app: http://localhost:8000/html_file

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[web3_2025-12-18_10-28-14.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24232197/web3_2025-12-18_10-28-14.zip)
